name: New Heaven
detailed_description:
New Heaven is an intense wave-based zombie shooter that throws you into a ravaged Earth, crawling with grotesque, mutated creatures born from a man-made virus. These horrors were unleashed by the world’s richest elite, who abandoned the planet and now watch safely from an orbital space station they built as a refuge for themselves. Fueled by greed, they released the virus to wipe out the lower classes — but one survivor refuses to be silenced.

As the player, you battle through endless waves of infected using a massive arsenal of upgradable weapons — from standard rifles and shotguns to experimental energy cannons. Earn money with every kill and headshot, and use your cash to buy new weapons, upgrade gear and unlock powerful perks.

But survival is just the beginning.

With each completed wave, you push closer to your goal: hijack the last remaining launch system and take the fight to the stars. As the action escalates, you uncover clues about the rich oligarchs’ betrayal and every step, is a step closer to the ultimate mission — storm the space station and make them pay.

Features:

  • Wave-based zombie combat with increasing difficulty and boss waves

  • Huge weapon variety: assault rifles, snipers and pistols.

  • Dynamic upgrade and perk system to customize your playstyle

  • In-game currency earned from kills and objectives

  • Story-driven progression toward an epic revenge mission in space

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: intel i5 8400 or Ryzen 2600/x
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: gtx 750 ti or amd R7 260
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: i5-10400 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: gtx 1660 or Radeon RX 590
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
